as_told.title: Jolly West, UCLA and MK Ultra

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jolly West, longtime head of psychiatry at UCLA, the University of California in Los Angeles, was one of the architects of MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme of mind-control experiments in the 1950s and 60s. Drawing on a book called CIA Doctors by the psychiatrist Colin Ross, Michels says West wrote back and forth with Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA scientist who ran the programme, and suggests West was probably using these methods on Charles Manson, the cult leader. If true, it would tie government mind-control work to the making of cults.
